skill.name: pdb-database
skill.description: Access RCSB Protein Data Bank APIs to search structures, retrieve metadata, and download PDB or mmCIF coordinate files for structural biology research.

content.value_statement: Structural biology work requires accurate structure IDs, metadata, and coordinate files. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through RCSB PDB searches and retrieval workflows.
actual_capabilities: Search PDB entries by text, attributes, sequence similarity, and structural similarity.
Retrieve entry, polymer entity, assembly, and GraphQL metadata from RCSB APIs.
Download PDB and mmCIF coordinate files from RCSB file endpoints.
Show batch retrieval patterns with rate limiting guidance.
Point users to RCSB documentation and Python client package resources.
limitations: Requires internet access to RCSB PDB APIs and file servers.
Does not validate biological conclusions or experimental quality by itself.
Examples depend on current RCSB API behavior and package compatibility.
Downloaded structures may need separate visualization or molecular analysis tools.

use_cases.title: Find Target Structures
use_cases.description: Identify PDB entries for a protein target, then compare methods, resolution, ligands, and organism data.

use_cases.title: Prepare Drug Discovery Inputs
use_cases.description: Collect candidate protein-ligand structures and coordinate files for docking, binding-site review, or assay planning.

use_cases.title: Build Teaching Examples
use_cases.description: Gather clear structure examples and metadata for classroom demonstrations or guided molecular visualization lessons.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Entries
prompt_templates.prompt: Find RCSB PDB structures for hemoglobin. Return relevant PDB IDs, methods, resolutions, and short selection notes.

prompt_templates.title: Filter By Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Search RCSB PDB for human kinase structures below 2.5 angstroms. Summarize IDs, ligands, and quality limits.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Safe Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workflow to download mmCIF files for 4HHB, 1MBN, and 1GZX. Include naming, checks, and rate limits.

prompt_templates.title: Design Research Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a research plan combining sequence similarity search, metadata retrieval, coordinate downloads, and quality filtering for my target protein.

output_examples.input: Find high-resolution hemoglobin structures in RCSB PDB.
output: A ranked shortlist of PDB IDs with method, resolution, release date, and organism.
Notes explaining which entries are best for visualization, comparison, or downstream modeling.

output_examples.input: Download coordinate files for selected PDB IDs.
output: A clear download plan with preferred mmCIF files, safe filenames, and expected RCSB endpoints.
Rate limit guidance and checks for missing, obsolete, or superseded identifiers.

output_examples.input: Compare candidate structures for a drug target.
output: A comparison table summary covering ligands, experimental method, resolution, and biological assembly notes.
A recommendation for which structures deserve manual inspection before modeling work.

best_practices: Validate PDB IDs before downloading files or building filenames.
Prefer mmCIF for modern structures and large biological assemblies.
Use rate limits, caching, and retries for batch API work.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the first search result as scientifically sufficient.
Do not ignore resolution, method, ligand state, or biological assembly context.
Do not run large batch downloads without delays or cache planning.

faq.question: What data source does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses RCSB Protein Data Bank APIs, file download endpoints, and related public documentation.

faq.question: Can it download coordinate files?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes PDB and mmCIF download workflows from RCSB file endpoints.

faq.question: Does it perform molecular visualization?
faq.answer: No. It helps retrieve data, but visualization requires separate tools such as PyMOL, ChimeraX, or notebooks.

faq.question: Can it search by sequence similarity?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sequence similarity examples using the RCSB Python API client.

faq.question: Is internet access required?
faq.answer: Yes. Searches, metadata retrieval, and downloads require access to RCSB services.

faq.question: Can it replace expert structural review?
faq.answer: No. Users must still review biological relevance, experimental quality, and downstream assumptions.
